d: A centaur-like hybrid creature with a human upper body and a four-legged equine lower body, featuring platinum white hair styled in thick, curling locks and a single large, curved dark brown horn protruding from the right side of the head. The eyes are closed in a serene expression, and the face possesses the soft, rounded features of a young adult. The build is slender and graceful, wearing a navy blue and gold cloth wrap around the waist and a gold ornamental collar, while holding a tall, dark spear with a silver pointed tip. BODY COLOR: Creamy white LEGS: Digitigrade with dark brown cloven hooves
